title: From Kuaishou Local Life to Kling AI: Liu Xiao Reportedly Leaves Kuaishou Recently

content_html:
It is reported that Liu Xiao, former head of local life at Kuaishou and head of commercial products at Kling AI, recently left Kuaishou. Before leaving, Liu Xiao held a job level of E15. As of press time, Kling AI had not yet officially responded. Separately, a person familiar with the matter told Sina Tech that information related to Liu Xiao can still be found through Kuaishou's OA system.

Public records show that Liu Xiao earned a bachelor's degree from Zhejiang University and a master's degree from Tsinghua University. Early in their career, Liu Xiao served as a senior investment manager at Fosun Group, and later joined the medical aesthetics platform SoYoung as chief operating officer.

In 2020, Liu Xiao joined Kuaishou and successively oversaw businesses including the Content Operations Center, the Real Estate and Recruitment Business Center, the Commercialization External Circulation and Basic Products Department, and the Kuaishou Alliance Product Department. In September 2025, Kuaishou upgraded its Local Life Business Unit to the Life Services Business Unit, and Liu Xiao became its head. In July 2026, Kuaishou carried out personnel adjustments, and Liu Xiao stepped down from the relevant position before transferring to Kling AI to take charge of commercialization.

This departure news involves personnel changes in Kling AI's commercialization team. As AI video generation products accelerate their commercialization, changes to relevant business leaders and organizational structures have also attracted industry attention.
